title: IELTS GT Writing Practice Test 13 — Invitation Letter
instructions: Task 1: Write a letter of at least 150 words. Task 2: Write an essay of at least 250 words.

questions.letterSituation: You and your family have recently moved into a new home in the neighbourhood. You would like to introduce yourself to your neighbours and invite them to a small housewarming gathering you are planning for the coming weekend.
questions.prompt:
You and your family have recently moved into a new home in the neighbourhood. You would like to introduce yourself to your neighbours and invite them to a small housewarming gathering you are planning for the coming weekend.

Write a letter in response to this situation. In your letter:
• introduce yourself and your family to your neighbours
• give details of the event including the date, time, and what guests can expect
• let them know what to bring if anything and how they can confirm their attendance

Write at least 150 words. You do NOT need to write any addresses.
questions.modelAnswer: A strong response should open with an appropriate greeting, address each bullet point in a separate paragraph with specific detail, maintain the correct register throughout, and close with a suitable sign-off.

questions.prompt: Some people believe that living in a close-knit community where neighbours know each other well offers significant benefits. Others feel that personal privacy and independence are more important. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
questions.modelAnswer: A strong response should present a clear position supported by well-developed arguments, relevant specific examples, and a logical structure including a focused introduction, detailed body paragraphs, and a concise conclusion.
